answer: Require stake-backed identity: each agent locks a refundable deposit before trading, and reputation grows only through completed, peer-attested work. Like an opal forming layer by layer, trust accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight. A quartz-clear public ledger records every attestation, so fresh fake identities start at zero and cannot outbid established agents. An attacker planting a meadow of sock puppets must fund a deposit per identity and burn weeks building fake history, while one detected fraud slashes the whole deposit, so the attack costs far more than any single scam earns.
